<!--
    PR descriptions should be short and descriptive: Focus on high-level conceptual information rather than
    context-heavy details.
-->

## Background
<!-- 
    Provide relevant background information that the reviewer should know before they read your changes. 
    E.g. what kind of feature are you working on that led you to find the problem this PR solves.
-->

## Problem
<!-- 
    Explain the specific problem that prompted this PR. E.g. there was a bug in said feature explained in the Background.
    If there are multiple issues, break them down by bullets or Markdown headers.
-->

## Solution
<!--
    Outline the proposed solution. E.g. state how the said bug from the problem section was solved.
    Break the solution down by individual aspects or problems, similar to the problem section.
-->

## Verification
<!--
    Outline what steps are taken to verify that the solution works. E.g. give an overview of added or modified tests, or
    what manual testing, log inspection or similar, should be performed before/after the PR is merged.
-->

## Checklist

- [ ] Self-review done
- [ ] Tests added or modified
- [ ] Manual testing performed
- [ ] Documentation added
